description: Check untrusted text or a web page URL for prompt injection before an agent reads it: instruction overrides, role and chat-template spoofing, exfiltration links, wallet-drain and key requests, commands, and hidden text (CSS-hidden elements, HTML comments, zero-width, Unicode tag smuggling, bidi). Rules plus an LLM judge; returns safe/suspicious/malicious, a 0-100 score, findings with evidence and the text with hidden characters removed. A screen, not a guarantee. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

model.description: Also ask the LLM judge (default true); false for rules only

text.description: The untrusted text to check, up to 50,000 characters

url.description: A web page to fetch and check instead of text (its HTML, including hidden parts)
